summary: Master humanitarian logistics and emergency supply chain training to improve dispatch speed, donor accountability, and crisis response. Enrol today.
lede: Humanitarian logistics covers the planning, movement, storage and tracking of relief supplies in crisis settings. For professionals in emergency operations, procurement, warehousing, transport and coordination, the training builds practical skills in assessing response times and stock visibility, planning urgent procurement and inventory controls, and mapping last-mile delivery and reporting performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in humanitarian operations, emergency logistics, procurement, warehousing, transport, reporting, or coordination and need to strengthen their day-to-day supply chain decisions.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises and simple dashboard work, plus a calculator for cost and inventory calculations. If available, prepare anonymized logistics data, stock records, procurement logs, transport schedules, or distribution reports from your current operation.
